title: Scripture and Culture
definition: Scripture and Culture means God’s Word judges, corrects, and guides every culture rather than being ruled by cultural values.
summary: Scripture and Culture means God’s Word judges, corrects, and guides every culture rather than being ruled by cultural values.
christFocus: Jesus is Lord over every people, nation, and age, and Scripture calls all cultures to bow before His truth and kingdom.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Every culture contains both traces of God’s common grace and evidence of human sin. Scripture helps believers discern what can be received with gratitude, what must be corrected, and what must be rejected.

God’s Word does not belong to one human culture. The Gospel goes to all nations, and Christ gathers people from every tribe and tongue. Yet every culture must be brought under Scripture, not placed above it.

Jesus confronts and redeems people from every background. Scripture and culture reminds believers that following Christ may challenge family patterns, social values, political idols, shame systems, addiction patterns, and accepted sins.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Believers often feel pulled between Scripture and the expectations around them. This doctrine gives courage to follow Christ when culture normalizes what God calls sin or shames what God calls faithful.

It also protects against confusing personal tradition with biblical truth. Not everything familiar is biblical, and not everything uncomfortable is unfaithful.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Let Scripture examine the culture around you and the culture inside you. Ask where your values, habits, fears, and loyalties need to be reshaped by Christ, and live as a faithful witness without pride or compromise.
